codex3_config_failure_root_cause.mechanism: Sandboxed HOME path expansion in scripts/sync_codex_account_configs.py
details: In scripts/sync_codex_account_configs.py line 24, HOME is evaluated as Path.home().
In the subagent execution environment, os.environ['HOME'] is overridden to /Users/kimlenglim/.ai-accounts/agy/account2.
ACCOUNT_CONFIGS['codex3'] therefore resolves to /Users/kimlenglim/.ai-accounts/agy/account2/.ai-accounts/codex/account3/config.toml, which does not exist.
The actual configuration file exists at /Users/kimlenglim/.ai-accounts/codex/account3/config.toml on the real host filesystem.
When scripts/sync_ai_agent_ecosystem.py executes scripts/sync_codex_account_configs.py --check, it inspects the final line of stderr/stdout, reporting the codex3 missing config error.

non_secret_repair_mechanism: 1. Path Resolution Resilience: Update scripts/sync_codex_account_configs.py to robustly resolve the true user home directory rather than relying solely on os.environ['HOME']. Fallback mechanisms include pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_dir, trimming .ai-accounts subpaths from Path.home(), or reading an explicit AI_ACCOUNTS_BASE_DIR / USER_HOME environment variable.

2. External Configuration Parity: Verify that /Users/kimlenglim/.ai-accounts/codex/account3/config.toml contains the required disabled skill entries using paths anchored to the true user home (/Users/kimlenglim/...).
3. Zero Secrets Policy: Neither config.toml nor inert profiles contain credentials, tokens, or API keys; repair touches only boolean flags, disabled skill paths, and model configurations.
